versions.changelog: Fewer steps for common questions: the listing shows metrics and the last day to join, brief shows how a competition is scored and its timeline, writeup takes several at once, and the submit dry run checks the file.
One entry point, competition operations (status, leaderboard, validate, submit, watch), a dry run for every write, public reads with Python only.

2.5.1: small fixes after 2.5.0 from the directory and registry scans (privacy policy URL in the plugin manifest, reworded credential list). Notes: https://github.com/shepsci/kaggle-skill/releases/tag/v2.5.1
2.5.0: fixes found against Kaggle CLI 2.2.4 and the MCP server (71 tools), a security pass, and refreshed references. Notes: https://github.com/shepsci/kaggle-skill/releases/tag/v2.5.0
Claude Code plugin format, bundled MCP server, OAuth 2.0 PKCE auth, privacy policy
Fix credential metadata mismatch, make Phase 5 instructions-only, add primaryEnv, add Scope of Operations section

Initial release: Comprehensive Kaggle integration skill for agentic systems.

- Supports account setup, API credential management, and guided registration.
- Generates competition reports with scraping and metadata analysis.
- Enables dataset/model downloads, notebook execution, competition submissions, and publishing.
- Includes automated badge earning (up to ~38 badges across 5 phases).
- Fully modular design with orchestrated workflows and compatibility for Python 3.9+.
- Strong focus on credential security with scripts, documentation, and best practices.
